Validated price · 62% below market average

The analysis of 10 comparables around José Ignacio shows prices between 110 and 232 USD/m² for similar products, with a weighted average of 170 USD/m². Brisas at USD 65/m² is positioned well below the market, with significant upside potential.

◈Scale
Lots of ~4,000 m² with 40% FOT allow residences of 1,550–1,714 m² total covered area. Difficult to replicate in the area.
◈Premium profile
Low density, privacy and natural surroundings as differentiating attributes. High-net-worth buyer profile.
◈Location
José Ignacio Lighthouse / Garzón area, with direct access to the high-end residential market and elite services.
◈Sales channel
Referrals, specialized operators and qualified word of mouth. Not mass-market. Selective niche marketing.
“Brisas de José Ignacio is a premium, low-density residential estate community aimed at selective buyers seeking privacy, natural surroundings and proximity to José Ignacio, with sufficient buildable capacity for high-end single-family residences.”
